run_ml_train_cli: run the ml_train CLI to train linear or random forest models on HER or CO2R experimental data
run_load_and_preprocess_data: run load_and_preprocess_data to load and merge experimental, computational, and XRD CSV datasets
run_add_el_features: run add_el_features to add Matminer elemental descriptors like atomic mass and radius to a dataframe
run_model_map: run cross-validation predictions using MODEL_MAP linear or random forest regressor models on OCx24 data
run_cross_val_predict_loop: run the loco_cv or loo_cv cross-validation loop to generate predictions and scatter plots with R2 and MAE
